description: This PHP file defines the 'Price' class within the 'PhpSpreadsheet' library, specifically handling various financial securities pricing calculations such as bond price, discounted price, price at maturity, and received amount. The class utilizes multiple helper classes for date handling, validation, constants, and calculations, and provides static methods for complex financial computations.

classes.name: Price
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate various security prices such as bond prices, discounted prices, and security maturity prices within the PHPSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: price
methods.description: Calculates the price per $100 face value of a security with periodic interest based on settlement date, maturity date, rate, yield, redemption, frequency, and basis.

methods.name: priceDiscounted
methods.description: Calculates the discounted price per $100 face value of a security given settlement date, maturity date, discount rate, redemption value, and basis.

methods.name: priceAtMaturity
methods.description: Calculates the security's price at maturity, considering settlement date, maturity date, issue date, interest rate, yield, and basis.

methods.name: received
methods.description: Returns the total amount received at maturity for a fully invested security based on settlement date, maturity date, investment amount, discount rate, and basis.
